capabilities: Set anchor link display text automatically to the linked heading name
Configure the display text format and heading separator
Suggest alternative display text formats next to existing anchor links
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.13.0 or later from v1.6 onward because of the new declarative settings API.
motivation: The author wants anchor links to look nicer while saving the time of manually typing display text after autocompleting a link.
problem: Obsidian anchor links show raw link text unless you manually add a display text after a vertical bar, which is tedious when autocompleting links.
summary: Automatically fills the display text of anchor links with the linked heading's name, with configurable formats and separators.
